Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime

Class OtterRuntime

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.OtterRuntime
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class OtterRuntime extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The central entry point for Otter Streams — the AI runtime layer that sits on top of the individual InferenceEngine implementations.

Where a bare InferenceEngine only knows how to load one model and answer infer() calls, OtterRuntime ties together:

  • ProviderRegistry — which engine implementations are available (Provider SPI)
  • ModelRegistry — where model configurations come from (by id/version)
  • LifecycleManager — safe validate → warm → swap → retire deployments
  • an optional result ModelCache
  • an optional MetricsCollector

This class is purely additive: every existing class ( InferenceEngine, ModelConfig, AsyncModelInferenceFunction, ...) continues to work exactly as before and does not require OtterRuntime to function. Using the runtime is opt-in.

Usage:


 OtterRuntime runtime = OtterRuntime.builder()
         .metrics(new MetricsCollector())
         .cache(new ModelCache<>(10_000, 30))
         .build(); // auto-discovers provider modules on the classpath via ServiceLoader

 ManagedModel model = runtime.deploy(ModelConfig.builder()
         .modelId("fraud-detector")
         .modelPath("file:///models/fraud_detection.onnx")
         .format(ModelFormat.ONNX)
         .modelVersion("1.0")
         .build());

 InferenceResult result = runtime.infer("fraud-detector", inputs);

 // later — hot-swap to a new version, zero code change for callers of infer("fraud-detector", ...)
 runtime.deploy(v2Config);

 runtime.close();

    • watch

      public void watch(String modelId, Duration pollInterval)
      Starts polling the configured ModelRegistry for new versions of modelId and automatically deploys them as they appear. Requires the model to already be resolvable via the registry (see ModelRegistry.resolve(com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi.ModelReference)); the first poll deploys it if it isn't already deployed.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to watch
      pollInterval - how often to check the registry for a new version

    • rollback

      public ManagedModel rollback(String modelId) throws DeploymentException
      Re-deploys the last previously-active version for a model, undoing the most recent hot swap. Goes through the full validate/warm flow again.
      Parameters:
      modelId - the model id to roll back
      Returns:
      the managed model, now back on the rolled-back version
      Throws:
      DeploymentException - if the rollback deployment fails validation/warmup
      IllegalStateException - if there is no prior version to roll back to

    • deployShadow

      public ManagedModel deployShadow(String modelId, ModelConfig config, double sampleRate) throws DeploymentException
      Deploys a shadow version: a sampled copy of traffic is mirrored to it asynchronously for comparison, never affecting what callers of infer(java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.Object>) receive.
      Parameters:
      sampleRate - fraction of traffic to mirror, from 0.0 (off) to 1.0 (all)
      Throws:
      DeploymentException - if validation/warmup of the shadow fails
